entries.text: Set typography rules for a writing language or an individual article, then check a saved Revision locally without AI. Review suggested corrections with the rules that support them before choosing what to accept.
Style Profile now has its own navigable screen, with sections for your profile, typography, guidance, and writing samples. A compact layout and clearer typography labels make settings easier to scan.
Desktop update settings show release notes for updates and disable Check Now while an update check is in progress.
